title: Riverside Clinic in Bend, Oregon switches infusion pump vendor
summary: Riverside Clinic, an independent outpatient surgical clinic in Bend, Oregon, has adopted a competing infusion pump line for its recovery bays, clinic administrators said this week. The clinic is not affiliated with any Midwest or Northeast hospital system.

title: Corvane Systems recalls C-40 pump line
summary: Corvane Systems issued a voluntary recall of its C-40 infusion pump line on 2026-08-26, citing a software defect identified during post-market surveillance. The company said replacement units are being prioritized for affected hospitals.
